menu.excluded_perk: Perk that prevents becoming a nemesis
menu.timing_reencounter: When the player encounters the NPC again
menu.name_help: Use {name} as the name base. When 'Continue previous tier name' is enabled, {name} means the final name from the previous tier; otherwise it means the original NPC name. Omit {name} to replace the complete name.
menu.maximum_nemeses_disclaimer: 0 = unlimited. The limit applies only to current nemeses; defeated nemeses free a slot.
